metadata.short_desc: Use your ChatGPT subscription in AstrBot without an API key.
metadata.desc: Sign in through local Codex or a device code, manage multiple accounts, and check remaining allowances. Enable automatic fallback to try another account when one is unavailable.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Manage ChatGPT sign-ins, provider settings and subscription allowances.

codex_auth_path.hint: Leave blank to read $CODEX_HOME/auth.json or ~/.codex/auth.json. In Docker, mount the entire credential directory; automatic refresh requires write access to that directory. Reload the plugin after saving.

chat_language.hint: Language of /usage, /effort and /openai_login replies. The plugin page follows the dashboard language. Reload the plugin after saving.
